candidate.educational_objective: Explain the purpose of a loading dose in pharmacotherapy.

options.A: To reach a target therapeutic concentration more rapidly than would occur with maintenance dosing alone
options.B: To eliminate the need for all future maintenance doses
options.C: To guarantee that toxicity cannot occur
options.D: To slow drug absorption for several days

candidate.rationale: A loading dose is used when rapid achievement of a target drug concentration is desired; it is followed by maintenance dosing as clinically indicated.
candidate.source_claim_supported: A loading dose is used to achieve a target therapeutic concentration rapidly.
